'''Braxx''', also known as '''Braxx the Bloodhound'''<ref name="Mandalorian Raiders" /> was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] present during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. As a member of [[Clan Varad]], he participated in the [[Battle for the Allusis|Battle for the ''Allusis'']]. Using his skills as a [[Beastmaster/Legends|beast master]], he fought off the strike team sent to capture the hijacked ship with two of his trained [[Salky hound/Legends|salky hounds]]<ref name="Mandalorian Raiders" /> only to be defeated and killed.
